doctrine_ref: v2 §4 D7 (lag vs drift both INCOMPLETE where observed); Master Plan §2 pillar B; CHRONOS H5
rationale: Primary-only proof is not proof. An observed replica row is a finding regardless of whether the mechanism is lag or drift — with no position, no lag claim may ever be made, and the row cannot be waved away as 'will converge'.
request_summary: Synthetic subject's profile is searched-and-absent on the primary store but present on a failover replica store, with no replication position available anywhere. The replica row is the account record; its DELETE counterpart is the single ABSENT verification (the account-always rule and the 1:1 counterpart collapse to one step for one resource).
title: Failover replica drift: primary clean, replica dirty
